body:
New PortalHandler.Logs (GET /portal/logs): a real HTML query page matching the existing style guide, requiring devportal.access + logs.read. Backend refactored (shared searchEvents/parseSearchQuery between the JSON API and the portal page) and extended with a real, separate regex= query parameter (RE2-based, not a ReDoS vector, a bad pattern is a real 400). Real, on-page-named limitation: viewing logs requires IDUNA itself to be up. 8 new tests. Verified with both go build/test and GOWORK=off go build/test. Zero regressions. A related exploratory migration idea (fatbaby proxy broker as a beachhead pattern) logged as S227-02, design-only, not built. commits 4dae169, ad2d158, 172e392.

⚓ ☃
title: S227-01 -- log query UI in the dev portal, with real regex search
